description: Spend Receipt: one signed receipt per purchase: what your agent bought, why, what it cost (verified on Base from the tx hash or PAYMENT-RESPONSE) and what came back (checked against the seller's advertised output). GOOD_BUY / PAID_NOT_DELIVERED / PAID_PARTLY_DELIVERED / PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED. Ed25519-signed, verifiable offline. Payment Verify + Delivery Check in one call. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/spend-receipt, $0.003 via x402.)
